title: Probe-vs-Output Knowledge Gap as a Function of Conflict Strength

original_idea.body:
# Probe-vs-Output Gap as a Function of Conflict Strength

Vary instruction strength pushing wrong answers; measure probe-knowledge-minus-stated-answer gap.
